title: Ray-Ban Meta Smart Glasses 20% off + Free Shipping @ Eye Concepts
body:
Deal: Ray-Ban Meta Smart Glasses 20% off + Free Shipping @ Eye Concepts

[Wiadro] 20% off creeper tools?
no thanks
Someone at my gym was wearing these and argued with the owner that it's his "right" to wear them. The gym owner, who is the size of a hunk, picked this kid up and carried him outside like he was a toddler.
I haven't seen him back.
[191919] bully the (profanity) out of anyone you see wearing this cringe shit
[Lizard Spock] Heads up* based on how our last Meta promo went, demand has been high enough that stock has taken up to 15 business days to arrive.
Great to see perversion is on the rise. /S
[WatchNerd] Isn't filming in public legal? There's cameras everywhere in 2026.
[lachlantula] it's much more obvious when someone's sticking a phone in your face vs using comparatively-regular-looking glasses
[freewhere] Just be careful with the 'use' .. in case u wanted that 'use' to be private. This has Zuckerberg inside.
[Big1] Transition version for that extra 70s pornstar vibe.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] I don't own these however just curious - what's with the hate? Is it that people might covertly film? You could just as easily do that with your smart phone if you were that way inclined, these at least apparently have a light that goes off, rather than a smart phone. I'd argue smart phones are worse.
If people were going to buy ranban glasses anyway surely having built in audio is handy for a bit more, I love my openshockz. Open to opinions either side!
[freewhere] Because it's far easier to record with glasses. People are way more conscious of a camera pointed (or even partially) at them.
[kron] Ray-Ban has completely ruined the brand by partnering with Meta.
[troyww] They sell $10 sunglasses for $300 and will partner with anyone . Meta is where their marketing goes too far ?
[cyssero] Arguably they may have done that when they sold to Luxottica some time ago.
[matashi1] Terrible style and bordering on illegal ..pass
[Spector1] illegal yet phones do the same thing without having a recording light
